abap.completionText: On successful completion of the course, you will receive a Course Completion Certificate that validates your practical training in SAP ABAP development, covering everything from core programming to real-time project work.
abap.description: Our focus stays on making sure you can actually perform the job — the certificate is proof of that capability, not just attendance.
highlights: Certificate includes details of modules covered and project work completed
Recognised by our placement partners and industry network in Raipur and beyond
Optional guidance provided for those who wish to pursue official SAP certification exams
Certificate is issued only after project submission and final assessment

ariba.completionText: On successful completion of the SAP Ariba course in Raipur, you will receive a Course Completion Certificate recognizing your hands-on training in Ariba Sourcing, Contracts, Procurement, and Supplier Management modules.
ariba.description: What the certificate reflects: Duration and modules completed, Practical/live project work undertaken, Skill areas covered during training. Additionally, our trainers will guide you on how to register for official SAP Ariba certification exams, exam pattern, structure, and preparation strategy, and building a certification-ready resume and LinkedIn profile.
highlights: Guidance for official SAP Ariba certification exams

basis.completionText: On successful completion of this SAP Basis training in Raipur, you will receive a course completion certificate recognizing your practical training and project work.
basis.description: Our trainers also guide students who wish to pursue official SAP certification, helping them understand exam patterns, question types, and preparation strategy.
highlights: Verifiable course completion certificate from the institute
Detailed skill and module breakdown mentioned on the certificate
Guidance and preparation support for global SAP certification exams
Certificate adds credibility to your resume and LinkedIn profile

fico.completionText: On successful completion of the course, you'll receive a Course Completion Certificate recognizing your training in SAP FICO, including the modules covered and the practical project work completed.
fico.description: For learners aiming for official SAP certification, our trainers will guide you on exam pattern, preparation resources, and how our training curriculum maps to SAP's certification syllabus.
highlights: Certificate reflects your training hours, curriculum covered, and hands-on project completion
Useful to include on your resume and LinkedIn profile when applying for SAP FICO roles
Guidance for official SAP certification exam

ewm.completionText: Every student who completes the course, including the live project and assessments, receives a course completion certificate in SAP EWM. The certificate reflects the modules covered, project work completed, and the duration of training.
ewm.description: While this is not an official SAP certification, it is recognized by hiring partners and recruiters we work with in Raipur, and it strengthens your profile when applying for SAP EWM or logistics-related roles. For students who want to pursue the official SAP certification exam, our trainers provide additional guidance, sample questions, and exam-pattern practice as part of the mentorship support.
highlights: Modules covered, project work completed, and duration of training
Recognized by hiring partners and recruiters in Raipur
Guidance for official SAP certification exam

mm.completionText: On successful completion of the course, you will receive a Course Completion Certificate recognising your training in SAP Materials Management.
mm.description: A completion certificate from a structured SAP MM Training in Raipur adds credibility to your resume and LinkedIn profile, especially when paired with the practical project work and case studies you complete during the course. For learners who wish to pursue the official SAP certification exam separately, our trainers also provide exam-oriented guidance and mock tests to help you prepare.
highlights: Modules covered and total training hours

bwbi.completionText: On successful completion of the course and project work, you will receive a verified SAP BW/BI course completion certificate that reflects your training duration and modules covered, hands-on project work completed during the course, a unique certificate ID for verification by employers, and recognition that supports your resume and LinkedIn profile.
bwbi.description: This certificate, combined with the practical project experience you gain, gives you a strong edge when applying for SAP BW/BI roles or freelance consulting opportunities.
highlights: Unique certificate ID for employer verification

ps.completionText: On successful completion of the course, you will receive a Course Completion Certificate in SAP Project Systems, recognizing your training hours, project work, and assessment scores.
ps.description: The certificate reflects hands-on exposure to real-time SAP PS scenarios and can be added to your resume and LinkedIn profile to strengthen your job applications. Guidance is also provided for those who wish to pursue official SAP global certification separately.
highlights: Recognizes training hours, project work, and assessment scores
Reflects hands-on exposure to real-time SAP PS scenarios
Guidance for official SAP global certification

pm.completionText: On successful completion of this SAP PM course in Raipur, you will receive a course completion certificate that validates your hands-on training in SAP Plant Maintenance concepts, configuration, and real-world project work.
pm.description: This certificate is designed to strengthen your resume and LinkedIn profile, and it's recognized by our placement and hiring partners as proof of practical, job-ready SAP PM skills. For students aiming for official SAP certification, we also provide guidance and structured preparation support to help you approach the SAP certification exam with confidence.
highlights: The modules and topics covered during training
Practical project work completed during the course

qm.completionText: On successful completion of the course and the capstone project, you will receive a Course Completion Certificate in SAP QM, recognized by employers and consulting firms as proof of practical, hands-on training.
qm.description: Guidance also provided for those who wish to pursue official SAP global certification separately.
highlights: Certificate includes modules covered, training duration, and project details
Awarded only after passing the final assessment and submitting the live project
Verifiable certificate with a unique ID for employer verification

pp.completionText: On successful completion of the SAP PP training in Raipur, you will receive a course completion certificate that validates your practical knowledge of SAP Production Planning concepts, configuration, and real-time scenarios.
pp.description: This certificate can be added to your resume and LinkedIn profile to strengthen your profile for SAP PP consultant roles.

hana.completionText: On successful completion of the SAP S/4 HANA course in Raipur, learners receive a Course Completion Certificate that reflects the modules covered, project work completed, and the duration of training.
hana.description: What the certificate includes: Learner's name and course duration, Modules and specialization track covered, Unique certificate ID for verification, Trainer or institute authorization.

hrhcm.completionText: On successful completion of the course, you will receive an industry-recognised SAP HCM Course Completion Certificate, along with a detailed project completion certificate based on your live project work, guidance and preparation support for global SAP certification exams, a verifiable certificate ID that can be added to your resume and LinkedIn profile, and a letter of recommendation for top-performing students (placement-track batches).
hrhcm.description: This certification adds credibility to your resume and demonstrates your practical, job-ready SAP HCM skills to recruiters.
highlights: Detailed project completion certificate based on live project work
Guidance and preparation support for global SAP certification exams
Verifiable certificate ID for resume and LinkedIn
Letter of recommendation for top-performing students

scm.completionText: On successful completion of the course, you will receive an SAP SCM Course Completion Certificate from [Institute Name], recognising your training in Materials Management, Sales & Distribution, Production Planning, and Warehouse Management concepts.
scm.description: Certificate reflects hands-on project work, not attendance alone. Adds credibility to your resume and LinkedIn profile. Assessment-based issuance (a short practical evaluation is conducted before certification). Digital and physical copies provided.
highlights: Reflects hands-on project work, not attendance alone
Adds credibility to your resume and LinkedIn profile

successfactors.completionText: On successful completion of this SAP SuccessFactors course in Raipur, you will receive a Course Completion Certificate recognizing your training and project work.
successfactors.description: We also prepare you separately for the official SAP Certified Application Associate — SAP SuccessFactors exam (module-specific, e.g., Employee Central or Recruiting), which is administered by SAP directly and is the credential employers actually look for. What's included in certificate preparation: Structured mapping of course content to the official exam blueprint, Practice tests and mock exams, Guidance on exam registration and exam-day process.
highlights: Recognizing your training and project work
Structured mapping to official exam blueprint

sd.completionText: On successful completion of the course, you will receive a Course Completion Certificate in SAP Sales and Distribution, which reflects total training hours completed, modules and topics covered, practical project work completed on the live SAP server, and trainer evaluation and assessment score.
sd.description: This certificate can be added to your resume and LinkedIn profile as proof of structured, hands-on SAP SD training. For students who also wish to pursue official SAP certification, our trainers provide guidance on exam patterns, eligibility, and preparation strategy separately, as official SAP certification is administered directly by SAP SE and is not included in the institute fee.
highlights: Practical project work on live SAP server

datascience.completionText: The Data Science Certification provides in-depth knowledge of data analysis, machine learning, and big data.
datascience.description: With hands-on training, you'll be prepared to apply data science techniques to solve complex problems.
highlights: Hands-on training in Python, R, SQL
Validates practical ML and analytics skills

dataanalytics.completionText: The Masters in Data Analytics Certification offers advanced training in data processing, statistical analysis, and reporting.
dataanalytics.description: You'll learn to use tools like Python, Excel, and Power BI to extract valuable insights.
highlights: Hands-on with Python, Excel, Power BI

businessanalytics.completionText: The Masters in Business Analytics Certification focuses on turning data into actionable business insights.
businessanalytics.description: Learn to use analytics tools to optimize business processes and drive growth.
highlights: Validates ability to turn data into insights

ai.completionText: The Generative AI Certification offers cutting-edge training in AI-powered conversational systems.
ai.description: Learn to develop chatbots, integrate AI into business processes, and create intelligent applications.
highlights: Hands-on with GPT models and chatbots

fullstack.completionText: The Full Stack Training Certification provides comprehensive skills in front-end and back-end web development.
fullstack.description: You'll learn to build dynamic web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Node.js.

java.completionText: The JAVA Certification Course is tailored for those looking to master the Java programming language.
java.description: Gain proficiency in building high-performance applications and scalable solutions.

python.completionText: The Python Certification equips you with versatile skills in one of the most popular programming languages.
python.description: Learn to use Python for data analysis, web development, and automation.
highlights: Hands-on for data analysis and automation

salesforce.completionText: The Salesforce Training Certification is designed to make you proficient in managing and configuring Salesforce CRM.
salesforce.description: Gain hands-on experience with Salesforce tools and automate workflows.

tableau.completionText: The Tableau Certification offers in-depth training in data visualization and dashboard creation.
tableau.description: You'll learn to present complex data insights through interactive visuals.

powerbi.completionText: The Power BI Certification trains you in Microsoft's leading business intelligence tool.
powerbi.description: Learn to create dynamic dashboards, perform data analysis, and share insights.

corehr.completionText: The Core HR Certification focuses on the essentials of human resources, including policies, employee management, and labor laws.
corehr.description: This certification ensures you are equipped to handle core HR functions.

hrpayroll.completionText: The HR Payroll Certification teaches you the intricacies of payroll management.
hrpayroll.description: From handling salary calculations to statutory compliances, this certification ensures you are well-prepared.

hrmanagement.completionText: The HR Management Certification offers advanced training in strategic HR practices.
hrmanagement.description: This certification prepares you for managerial roles in HR.

hrgeneralist.completionText: The HR Generalist Certification covers all key HR functions, from recruitment to payroll management.
hrgeneralist.description: This well-rounded program provides the skills you need to efficiently manage HR operations.

hranalytics.completionText: The HR Analytics Certification focuses on using data to optimize HR processes.
hranalytics.description: Learn to analyse workforce metrics, improve recruitment strategies, and enhance employee performance.

hrtraining.completionText: The HR Training Certification provides a solid foundation in human resource management.
hrtraining.description: This certification prepares you to handle the daily operations of an HR department.

sap.completionText: The Connecting Dots SAP Certification Course is designed to enhance your expertise in SAP systems.
sap.description: Our program goes beyond theoretical learning, offering hands-on practical sessions across various SAP modules.

itcourses.completionText: The Connecting Dots Software Certification Course provides in-depth knowledge and hands-on experience in key software development technologies.
itcourses.description: Our comprehensive program covers programming languages, development frameworks, and industry best practices.

hrcourses.completionText: Master the art of Human resources with HR Certification Course designed to equip you with essential skills.
hrcourses.description: Our comprehensive program combines theoretical learning with hands-on practical sessions.

datavisualization.completionText: Learn advance topics and industrial tools with the Certification of Data Visualization Course.
datavisualization.description: Our program blends theoretical concepts with hands-on training, focusing on Tableau, Power BI, and Excel.
highlights: Hands-on with Tableau, Power BI, Excel
Validates ability to transform complex data
